source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary:
After this unit shoots in your [Shooting phase](vsdata:core-rule/shooting-phase), if every Mek Gunz model in it carries the same ranged weapons, pick 1 enemy unit that those attacks hit. Until your next turn starts, that unit has the effect named after that weapon:

- **Bubblechukka**: it is **wobbled**, so the targets of its attacks gain the **[Benefit of Cover](vsdata:core-rule/benefit-of-cover)** against them
- **Kustom Mega-kannon**: it is **zapped**, with −1 **Ld**
- **Smasha Gun**: it is **smashed**, with −2" **M**
- **Traktor Kannon**: it is **grounded** and cannot [take to the skies](vsdata:core-rule/flying-models)

Each Mek Gun model starts with 5 Grot Crew tokens beside it. Remove 1 each time that model loses a wound; the model itself stands for its final wound.
